get-involved.text3: Bring your curiosity, your knowledge or a challenge worth solving. There is more than one way to contribute.
get-involved.text5: Connect around data and AI, exchange ideas and explore ways to learn together.
get-involved.text6: Tell us about your interests, the skills you want to develop and the experience you would like to share.
get-involved.text8: Help make useful Somalia-related data easier for others to discover and understand.
get-involved.text9: Prepare a dataset description, its source, time period, format and reuse license. Share only data you have permission to make available, with personal information removed where needed.
get-involved.text11: Explore research, training or digital solutions around a challenge your organization faces.
get-involved.text12: Describe your challenge, the people it affects, any available data and what a useful outcome would look like.
get-involved.text13: A shared question can be the start of useful work.
